data.title: Off (Original)
data.itemDescription: Maintains the original sample rate, preserving the source audio characteristics.

data.title: 2x (Standard)
data.itemDescription: Improves basic smoothness for a more refined listening experience.

data.title: 4x (High Resolution)
data.itemDescription: Enhances detail and clarity for a more transparent sound.

data.title: 8x (High Precision)
data.itemDescription: Further improves resolution, delivering a more natural and detailed sound.

data.title: 16x (Ultimate)
data.itemDescription: Maximum precision processing for a more analog-like and lifelike sound.
